## LEGACY\_DEFAULTS variable

Pre-4.3.0 defaults, applied when `security.legacyDefaults: true` (ADR-103). Each entry records the reverted item for the startup WARN summary.

**Signature:**

```typescript
LEGACY_DEFAULTS: Array<{
    path: string;
    value: unknown;
    reason: string;
}>
```
